shiftHandovers.summary: Busy morning OPD shift with 28 total consultations. 2 patients currently under active clinical observation in Bay A. Urgent Troponin-I and ECG review required for Titly.

patientHandovers.criticalChanges: Admitted from OPD with acute epigastric pain radiating to back & palpitations. BP spiked to 140/92 mmHg, PR 104 bpm. Initial ECG: sinus tachycardia with mild ST flattening in V4-V6.
patientHandovers.urgentFollowUps: 1) Review Repeat Troponin-I stat (sample sent at 01:15 PM). 2) Check Serum Amylase/Lipase result. 3) If pain continues >30 mins after Omeprazole IV, call Cardiology consult.

patientHandovers.criticalChanges: Fasting Blood Sugar was 14.8 mmol/L on arrival with HbA1c 9.6%. Mild peripheral burning pain in feet. Given subcutaneous regular insulin 6 units.
patientHandovers.urgentFollowUps: Check post-insulin 2-hour blood glucose at 03:30 PM. Advise on diabetic meal & insulin pen titration before discharge.

shiftHandovers.summary: Night emergency on-call was largely calm. One patient with acute bronchial asthma nebulized and stabilized; discharged early morning.

patientHandovers.criticalChanges: Came at 11:30 PM with acute wheezing & SpO2 91%. Nebulized with Salbutamol + Ipratropium twice, IV Hydrocortisone given. SpO2 improved to 97%.
patientHandovers.urgentFollowUps: Prescribed Budecort MDI inhaler with spacer. Advised OPD pulmonology follow-up in 3 days.

shiftHandovers.acknowledgementNotes: Shift taken over. Patient was ambulatory and discharged with inhaler technique education.
